Exhaustive brute force at orders 1–6 and polynomial identities check implementation independently; finite experiments are not substituted for proof.

value.rationale: Ladders are the canonical two-row Cartesian grid and are not tree cases covered by known tree packing algorithms. The result enumerates every feasible cardinality, determines a nontrivial rational two-parameter polynomial, proves the all-order exact maximum, and classifies/residue-counts every maximum configuration using alternating stars, adding structural information absent from the injective edge-coloring index.
